newsitem.title: ITALY: Mediaset Q1 97 advertising income up 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mediaset Q1 97 advertising income up 10 pct.

text.p: Italian multi-media group Mediaset sees 1997 as a year of strong growth with advertising revenue already up 10 percent in the first three months of the year, chairman Fedele Confalonieri said.
This increase was well above the average increase in the sector, he told the group's annual shareholders' meeting.
The television and advertising group, part of Silvio Berlusconi's Fininvest SpA empire, posted 1996 pre-tax profit of 835.4 billion lire against 578.1 billion.
Managing Director Ubaldo Livolsi said earlier this month he expected Mediaset to achieve an increase in 1997 turnover of possibly more than five percent, helped by the rise in advertising revenue.

The shareholders' meeting was given an updated list of shareholders with stakes of over two percent. These included Fininvest with 50.007 percent, Nethold Italy BV (6.4 pct), Kirsch group (5.4 pct), U.S. fund USA Capital Research Management (2.9 pct), Al Waleed group (2.29 pct) and Albacom Holding Ltd (2.10 pct).
